claims.evidence: No size markings, origin stamps, or manufacturer plate visible in either photo; 'MX' handwritten mark does not confirm capacity or origin.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No certification sticker, inspection stamp, or test date visible in photos; no leak test clip provided.
Brass valve fitting is visible in Photo 1 but condition/age cannot be judged from a static image; no close-up of valve markings or threading.

risks.risk: Actual gas capacity differs from claimed 12kg
risks.proof: Clear photo of stamped capacity marking on the cylinder neck/shoulder
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown/smallest common size until confirmed

risks.risk: Cylinder is empty rather than filled
Valve or threading incompatible with local regulators
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of valve threading and type
risks.if_unproven: price as needing adaptor or unknown compatibility

risks.risk: No valid inspection or certification date (safety/legal risk)
risks.proof: Photo of certification stamp or inspection date engraved on collar

risks.risk: Dents, rust, or corrosion hidden under netting
risks.proof: Photo with netting removed showing full body
risks.if_unproven: price as for cosmetic/structural damage present

risks.proof: Photo showing regulator/hose included in sale
risks.if_unproven: price as cylinder only, no accessories

risks.proof: Short video of soap-water leak test on valve and body

proof_requests: Photo of the stamped capacity (kg) and manufacture/inspection date on the cylinder collar
Close-up of valve threading and any certification marks
Video of cylinder being weighed or gauge showing fill level
Photo/video of netting removed to show full body condition
Soap-water leak test video on valve and seams
Photo confirming whether a regulator/hose is included
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a gas cylinder, so it can be priced at worst case (unknown capacity, unverified fill, uncertified, possible hidden damage) pending the listed proofs.
